+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from bank import ledger, money
+from bank.api import create_app
+
+
+class CurrencyListTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        folder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.addCleanup(folder.cleanup)
+        path = Path(folder.name) / "currencies.db"
+        ledger.open_db(path).close()
+        self.client = TestClient(create_app(path, seed_if_empty=False))
+
+    def test_currencies_are_listed_in_code_order(self):
+        response = self.client.get("/api/currencies")
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        codes = [item["code"] for item in response.json()]
+        self.assertEqual(codes, sorted(money.EXPONENTS))
+
+    def test_each_currency_has_its_decimals(self):
+        response = self.client.get("/api/currencies")
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        listed = {item["code"]: item["decimals"] for item in response.json()}
+        for code, decimals in money.EXPONENTS.items():
+            with self.subTest(code=code):
+                self.assertEqual(listed.get(code), decimals)
